an7.1:1.1: Namo Tassa Bhagavato Arahato Sammāsam- buddhassa. I. 1. Evam me sutaṃ.
an7.1:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
an7.1:1.5: Bhadante ti te bhikkhū Bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
an7.1:2.1: Sattahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu sabrahmacārīnaṃ appiyo ca hoti amanāpo ca agaru ca abhāvanīyo ca.
an7.1:2.3: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu lābhakāmo ca hoti sakkārakāmo ca anavaññattikāmo ca ahiriko ca anottappī ca pāpiccho ca micchādiṭṭhi ca.
an7.1:2.4: Imehi kho bhikkhave sattahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu sabrahmacārīnaṃ appiyo ca hoti amanāpo ca agaru ca abhāvanīyo ca. 4.
an7.1:3.1: Sattahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu sabrahmacārīnaṃ piyo ca hoti manāpo ca garu ca bhāvanīyo ca.
an7.1:3.3: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu na lābhakāmo ca hoti na sakkārakāmo ca na anavaññattikāmo ca hirimā ca ottappī ca appiccho ca sammādiṭṭhi ca.
an7.1:3.4: Imehi kho bhikkhave. sattahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu sabrahmacārīnaṃ piyo ca hoti manāpo ca garu ca bhāvanīyo cā
